title: CoreRecordWindow billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = CoreRecordWindow (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 8. A line date is inside the core record's open / close dates plus grace days, and the core record is not closed. The dates are the core record's, never copied here. Parameters only: no rates, timekeepers or code descriptions, and no consequence (that is the sprk_consequence column). additionalProperties=false: any other member is refused, not ignored. 'messageTemplate' (anywhere) and 'then' are refused by RuleBodySchemaValidator before this schema runs.
